ido.question: A school asks for a rating from 1 to 5 inclusive. Keep asking while the integer rating is invalid, then print Accepted.

steps.title: First input
steps.explanation: The test requires a numeric rating, so cast the input to int.

steps.title: Write the invalid condition
steps.explanation: A rating is invalid below 1 OR above 5.
steps.code:
rating = int(input("Rating?"))
while rating < 1 OR rating > 5

steps.title: Re-read within the loop
steps.explanation: Update rating inside the WHILE to avoid an infinite loop.
steps.code:
rating = int(input("Rating?"))
while rating < 1 OR rating > 5
    rating = int(input("Try again:"))
endwhile

steps.title: Output after validation
steps.explanation: A valid rating exits the loop before Accepted is displayed.
steps.code:
rating = int(input("Rating?"))
while rating < 1 OR rating > 5
    rating = int(input("Try again:"))
endwhile
print("Accepted")

wedo.question: Enter a school-house number from 1 to 4. Re-prompt while the integer is outside that range, then print Ready.

steps.title: Input and convert
steps.explanation: Enter a number first before testing the loop.

steps.title: Condition and repeat input
steps.explanation: Both out-of-range cases are joined by OR; update the stored number.
steps.code:
house = int(input("House?"))
while house < 1 OR house > 4
    house = int(input("Again:"))

steps.title: Finish and check
steps.explanation: Explain what happens when the initial input is already valid.
steps.code:
house = int(input("House?"))
while house < 1 OR house > 4
    house = int(input("Again:"))
endwhile
print("Ready")

wedo.question: A quiz accepts difficulty levels 1, 2 or 3. Input an integer, repeat until valid, then print Start. Build it without blanks.
wedo.scaffold:

steps.title: Read a level
steps.explanation: Write your full solution before revealing any stages.

steps.title: Write the repeat-until-valid behaviour
steps.explanation: The same variable must be updated on every invalid entry.
steps.code:
level = int(input("Level?"))
while level < 1 OR level > 3
    level = int(input("Choose again:"))
